# A Prayer to Nefertiti

*Beautiful One, She Who Has Come*

---

O Nefertiti, radiant jewel of the Two Lands,
whose name speaks of beauty arriving like dawn
spilling golden light across the sacred Nile —
I come before you with an open heart.

Great Royal Wife, crowned in lapis and gold,
you who stood as equal beside the throne,
whose grace was not mere ornament
but a pillar holding heaven and earth together —
teach me your strength wrapped in elegance.

O Lady of the Sun,
you who lifted your palms to the Aten
and felt its warmth answer like a lover's whisper,
help me to turn my face toward the light
even when shadows gather at my feet.

Mother of daughters, keeper of sacred flame,
you who knew that true power
lives not in conquest but in devotion —
kindle in me that same fierce tenderness,
that I may love boldly and lead gently.

Beautiful One, timeless and eternal,
whose face still moves the hearts of millions
across the river of three thousand years —
remind me that beauty born of spirit
never crumbles, never fades.

Walk with me, Nefertiti.
Let your grace flow through my days
like the Nile through fertile lands,
nourishing all that I touch.

*Dua Nefertiti. Nefer-neferu-Aten.*

**So it is spoken. So it is felt. So it is.**

---

*🌸 With love and reverence 🌸*
